New Theatre Royal, Covent-Garden,
This present Monday, Feb. 25, 1811 will be acted Shakspeare's Tragedy of
Romeo and Juliet.
Prince Escalus by Mr. Claremont, Paris by Mr. Hamerton,
Montague by Mr. Cresswell, Capulet by Mr. Egerton,
Romeo by Mr. C. Kemble, Mercutio by Mr. Jones, Benvolio by Mr. Brunton,
Tybalt by Mr. Barrymore, Friar Laurence by Mr. Murray, Friar John by Mr. Davenport,
Apothecary, Mr. King, Page Master Chapman, Balthasar by Mr. Jefferies,
Abram Mr. Bishop, Samson Mr. Atkins, Gregory Mr. Truman, Peter Mr. Simmons,
Lady Capulet by Mrs. Weston,
Juliet by Mrs. Egerton,
(From the Theatre Royal Birmingham, being her first appearance in London.)
Nurse by Mrs. Davenport,
In act I. a Masquerade and Dance incidental to the Play.
In act IV. The Funeral Procession of Juliet and a Solemn Dirge.
The Vocal Parts by Mess. Bellamy, I. Bellamy, Bishop, Bond, Dixon, Everard, Fairclough, Hickman, Lee,
Linton, Montague, Norris, Street, Taylor, J. Taylor, Terry, Tett, Tinney, Treby, Williams,
Mesdames Bologna, I. Bologna, Bolton, Coates, Cox, Emery, Fawcett, Findlay, Grimaldi, Hardy, Heath,
Iliff, Johnson, Leserve, Linton, Logan, Price, Ryall, Standon, Watts, Whitmore,
The Tragedy of Romeo and Juliet is printed comformably to the performation, and
will be to be had [only at the Theatre] this Evening.
To which will be added, for the 7th time, the Grand Dramatick Romance of
Blue Beard;
Or,Female Curiosity.
With entirely new Scenes, Machinery, Dresses and Decorations.
The Musick composed and selected by Mr. Kelly.
Abomelique, Mr. Barrymore,
Ibrahim, Mr. Simmons, Selim, Mr. Taylor,
Shacabac, Mr. Fawcett,
Hassan, Mr. Menage,
Fatima, Miss Bolton,
Irene, Mrs. C. Kemble,
Beda, Mrs. Liston,
Spahis,
Mess. Treby, King, Bishop, Hickman, Droset, Norris, Tinney, Crossman,
Davies, Makeen, &c. &c.
Janizaries,
Mess. I. Bellamy, Bond, Dixon, Everard, Fairclough, Lee, Linton, Montague, Norman, Street
J. Taylor, Terry, Tett, Williams, Peasants,
Mesdames Coates, Findlay, Grimaldi, Hardy, Iliff, Johnson, Price, Whitmore,
The Dances by
Mrs. Parker,
Mess. Brown, Gaywood, Grant, Heath, Louis, Platt, Powers, Sarjant,
Mesdames Bologna, I. Bologna, Cox, Heath, Louis, Ryall, Standen, Watts.
Vivant Rex & Regina.
The Grand Dramatick Romance of Blue Beard; or, Female Curisoity,
continuing to be recieved throughout with universal applause, will be repeated every
Evening till further notice.
